research_window.scope: Local Greek environmental news and media-reported environmental-law incidents

import_guard.recommendation: Import only after admin review. Keep excluded_from_ranking=true until the issue has been independently verified and delivered through Drosia's authority workflow.
import_guard.source_retention: The current reports table has no source_url/source_type fields. Preserve source_urls in an admin note, sidecar table, or future report_sources table before production import.
import_guard.photo_policy: Do not reuse media photos unless licensed. Use field verification photos or licensed images, then run the normal server-side anonymization pipeline before public display.
import_guard.privacy_policy: Do not name suspects, private persons, or private parcels in public copy. Use approximate public-area pins when an article points to private land.

reports.title: Informal dump with construction and mixed waste near Vergia
reports.description: Media lead from ERTnews and Proto Thema: police reported large volumes of construction/demolition and mixed solid waste near Vergia, Halkidiki, connected to informal dumping. Needs field verification and an anonymized/licensed photo before public promotion.

reports.title: Informal dump with mixed solid waste near Nea Silata
reports.description: Media lead from ERTnews and Proto Thema: the second named Halkidiki site was reported around Nea Silata, with mixed solid waste including wood, mattresses, plastics, and old furniture. Verify the site and avoid exposing any private parcel.

reports.title: Construction and demolition waste dumping in rural Koufalia
reports.reported_window: Reported activity over approximately the previous 20 days.
reports.description: Media lead from ERTnews: police reported uncontrolled backfilling/dumping of construction and demolition waste in rural areas of Koufalia, part of a case involving 56 loads across Thessaloniki and Pella. Verify exact location before import.

reports.title: Construction and demolition waste dumping in rural Athyra
reports.reported_window: Reported activity over approximately the previous 20 days.
reports.description: Media lead from ERTnews: the same 56-load construction/demolition waste case included uncontrolled dumping in rural Athyra, Pella. Treat as a separate map report because it routes to a different municipality.

reports.title: Untreated sewage reached the sea at Agia Varvara, Nikiti
reports.reported_window: Reported as a short-duration failure of the biological treatment system.
reports.description: Media lead from ERTnews: untreated sewage reportedly reached the sea at Agia Varvara, Nikiti, after a double failure at the biological treatment plant; the water color visibly changed and swimming was banned. Requires current water-status verification.

reports.title: Sewage pipe break at Akrotiri beach, Pefkochori
reports.reported_window: Reported on 2026-06-12 after an overnight leak.
reports.description: Media lead from ERTnews: a sewage transfer pipe break at Akrotiri beach, Pefkochori, reportedly sent untreated sewage to the sea; swimming was banned 200 m on both sides pending water tests. Verify whether the ban remains active.

reports.title: Liquid and solid waste reportedly dumped toward the sea on Agistri
reports.description: Media lead from ERTnews: police reported liquid and solid waste being transported and dumped at points ending in the sea on Agistri, including liquid waste from trucks and construction waste on a steep slope. Needs exact public-safe pin verification.

reports.title: Illegal landfill report at Fryligkos, Milos
reports.reported_window: Reported after a complaint about an illegal landfill.
reports.description: Media lead from ERTnews: police reported municipal garbage trucks depositing solid urban waste at Fryligkos, Milos, outside the defined uncontrolled disposal area. Exact site geocoding is required before public map use.

reports.title: Animal and food waste reportedly buried near the Louros river
reports.reported_window: Reported on 2025-10-29; waste was said to have been unloaded the previous Friday.
reports.description: Media lead from ERTnews: more than 200 tons of animal and food waste from a Corfu fire cleanup were reportedly buried without authorization beside the Louros river near Filippiada. Use a public-area pin until the exact site is legally safe to show.

reports.title: Hazardous e-waste and oil contamination in Aspropyrgos
reports.reported_window: Reported arrest on 2026-02-15 after inspection on 2026-02-11.
reports.description: Media lead from ERTnews: inspection at a used-vehicle business in Aspropyrgos reportedly found electrical-equipment waste and lubricating oils on soil, causing environmental burden. Keep exact business details out of public copy.
